title: spec: export the controlled_by_parent master predicate, so a producer does not restate ADR-0055 §1's exactly-one-master rule
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`) from objectstack-ai/cloud#2865 `6146363767`. An enhancement, not a defect.

`refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) and `cbpMasterCandidates` (`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`) are module-private. objectql's exported `resolveMasterDetailRelation` counts any `master_detail`, required or not. So cloud's AI default (`sharing-model.ts`) restates the exactly-one-master rule and pins its copy with a test against `ObjectSchema`. Exporting the predicate would let a producer ask the spec. This is the same request as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23235 for the dimension group key.

`priority:p3`: cloud works today, and this does not block cloud's v18 upgrade.
